---

Now your navbar will smooth scroll to sections on your home page. Make sure to add corresponding ID attributes to your home page sections. For example:

```tsx
<section id="home">
  {/* Home section content */}
</section>

<section id="products">
  {/* Products section content */}
</section>
```

The scrolling function includes an 80px offset to account for the navbar height, which you can adjust based on your design. The smooth scrolling works in both desktop and mobile views, and the mobile menu automatically closes after selecting a section.
